Has it really been an entire year[XENO:n ]
since the Battle of Sword Valley?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]That was a rough time for us[XENO:n ]
Homs. Lots of people died.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Sometimes I think I'm cursed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It's not right that I survived the[XENO:n ]
battle when so many did not.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・I was glad/・Don't talk like that! ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Fiorung too. The smile on her face[XENO:n ]
went from ear to ear.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I remember.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]But it was a big shock seeing you[XENO:n ]
carried in on a stretcher like that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I'd prefer it if you didn't bring that[XENO:n ]
up. I wasn't exactly thrilled.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・That's impossible/・I know how you feel. ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]That's fair enough I suppose.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You can't help that you saw me[XENO:n ]
in such an embarrassing state.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]That's not what I meant at all![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I was jealous of you, man. I was[XENO:n ]
so upset that I didn't get to fight.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]What?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT5 ]I was a Defence Force soldier too.[XENO:n ]
I had every right to join the battle.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You needn't[XENO:n ]
feel guilty.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Defending the colony was an important[XENO:n ]
duty in its own right, wasn't it?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Yeah, yeah, I know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But I felt so...confused. Like,[XENO:n ]
conflicted about staying back.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]This is the first I've heard of it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]That's 'cos I've never[XENO:n ]
told anyone before.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Hah! Not like you to keep quiet[XENO:n ]
about something.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]It wasn't a good day for me either.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I was so jealous of you![XENO:n ]
It burned me up![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Jealous? Why?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Did you want to fight at the[XENO:n ]
Battle of Sword Valley?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT5 ]I was in the Defence Force too![XENO:n ]
I wanted to fight alongside you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I couldn't have taken you[XENO:n ]
along with me back then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][System:PageBreak ]But things are different now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You're far stronger than[XENO:n ]
you were a year ago,[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]both physically and mentally.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]Haha! Watch yer back, Dunban![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]'Cos I'm gonna overtake you[XENO:n ]
before you know it![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]When that day comes,[XENO:n ]
I'll be waiting.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But know this... It's going to be[XENO:n ]
no walk in the park![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT21 ]Dunban, the Hero of the Homs,[XENO:n ]
has laid down the gauntlet. It's on![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]You've gotta know how much[XENO:n ]
Fiorung worried when you left![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]You raise a valid point.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]She spent all her days[XENO:n ]
wishing you'd come back safe.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We used to hang out in the park.[XENO:n ]
She'd just stare into the sky...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Now that I didn't know...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・I'm the same/・I'm different, though ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I spent the whole time hoping[XENO:n ]
you'd get home ASAP.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I...never would have imagined.[XENO:n ]
I'm sorry I worried you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Easy! You're freaking me out.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]People might think you[XENO:n ]
actually like me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]And we can't have that, can we?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]I guess what we're doing now[XENO:n ]
makes up for all that though.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You and me, shoulder to shoulder.[XENO:n ]
I could get used to this.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You're stronger and fitter than[XENO:n ]
a year ago. Almost a new person.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But you've still got a long way[XENO:n ]
to go. Don't forget that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Well that lasted all of one minute.[XENO:n ]
Thought you and me were bonding![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Really? You weren't[XENO:n ]
worried at all?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Not really.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]'Cos somehow I knew you were[XENO:n ]
gonna make it back OK.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Heh. That's[XENO:n ]
just like you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]You were pretty banged[XENO:n ]
up though.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Anyone else wouldn't[XENO:n ]
have made it back.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Maybe it's just 'cos Fiorung[XENO:n ]
wished so hard.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Knowing Fiorung, you might[XENO:n ]
well be right![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
